paper_metadata.title: Improved approximation algorithms for bounded-degree local Hamiltonians

summary: The paper proves that for bounded‑degree 2‑local Hamiltonians, applying a shallow quantum circuit of depth (d+1) to a product state can increase the expected energy by Ω(Var(H)^2/(d^2|E|)), improving approximation ratios for problems such as quantum Max‑Cut. Additional results extend the bound to bounded‑depth input states with improvement Ω(Var(H)^2/(ℓ^10 d^2 |E|)) and show that random product states can be improved by Ω(quad(H)^2/(d|E|)) (or Ω(quad(H)/√d) on triangle‑free graphs). All contributions are analytical with no experimental benchmarking.
